title: Why Do We Sweat? Your Built-In Air Conditioner!

lines.text: You're sprinting across the soccer pitch, kicking the ball, and dripping wet!
lines.caps: You're sprinting across the *FIELD, | kicking the ball, and dripping *WET!

lines.text: Why does your body pump salty water out of your forehead when you run fast?
lines.caps: Why does your body pump *WATER | out of your forehead when you *RUN?

lines.text: Your muscles act like car engines; when they work hard, they burn energy and create heat!
lines.caps: Your muscles are like *ENGINES; | when they work hard, they create *HEAT!

lines.text: You have over three million microscopic sweat glands all across your skin!
lines.caps: You have over three *MILLION | microscopic sweat glands across your *SKIN!

lines.text: Your brain signals these glands to release a thin layer of ninety-nine percent water!
lines.caps: Your brain signals these *GLANDS | to release a thin layer of *WATER!

lines.text: Here comes the genius physics trick: evaporative cooling!
lines.caps: Here comes the genius *PHYSICS | trick: evaporative *COOLING!

lines.text: As the outdoor breeze blows across your skin, water transforms into vapor!
lines.caps: As the outdoor breeze *BLOWS, | water transforms into *VAPOR!

lines.text: It steals heat energy directly off your skin, keeping your body safe from overheating!
lines.caps: It steals heat energy right off your *SKIN, | keeping you safe from *OVERHEATING!

lines.text: Stay hydrated and curious—subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo!
